limitations: Counts are table-row observations, field-row cells and exact native-reference observations; they are not deduplicated people, companies or confirmed exposures.
The users and cloud_users exports overlap through a one-to-one native reference. Their Hong Kong-linked counts and email-shaped counts must not be added.
Hong Kong is an exact literal in a tenant country field. It does not establish an individual residence, a Hong Kong legal entity, customer status, resource ownership or a current relationship.
Email shape uses a simple fixed lexical grammar. No mailbox, deliverability, identity or uniqueness is verified. Native nonempty strings failing that grammar remain separate.

Only the 173 contracted top-level fields and 14 reference edges were analyzed. Unknown field occurrences were counted without retaining their names or values; this is not all-field or content-semantic review.
Text-body presence and lengths do not establish confidential content. Attachment metadata and URL strings do not establish file bytes, accessibility or availability. No linked URL was accessed.
OAuth-named tables provide identity/application/grant metadata under this contract; usable credentials or token-value material have not been established.
Role and lifecycle code meanings were not interpreted. Salesforce flags describe saved fields, not current employment, account access or Hong Kong affiliation.

Both passes share the parser, decompressor/runtime, SQLite/ctypes storage, advisory flock coordination, namespace planning and validation boundary. Independent encoders/reducers are not independent decoders.

Selected nested streams were freshly checked for exact sizes, compressed/decoded hashes and gzip CRC/EOF. Whole-archive SHA256 and outer EOF remain inherited; the user skipped a standalone whole-archive checksum.

Resource limits are sampled with structural database/journal bounds, not kernel quotas. Advisory locks assume cooperating writers; native overshoot, incomplete runtime/OS closure, live-orphan risk and fail-closed postcommit crash loss remain.
Two earlier failed attempts remain failures and add no coverage. The precise original key-limit dimension and later path-guard cause remain unconfirmed. No partial rows or databases were reused.
